tagline.en: Thinking in the open. Staying curious.

bio.zh: 这里是一处安静的数字花园。收集技术与设计的交点，也记下生活里值得停留的瞬间。
bio.en: A quiet corner of the internet. Exploring where technology meets design, and noticing the small things in between.

about.zh: 我喜欢把复杂的事物想清楚，再用简单的方式表达出来。在这里，我写代码、做实验，也记录阅读、散步和日常的观察。
about.en: I like making sense of complicated things and finding simple ways to express them. Here I write code, make experiments, and keep notes on books, walks, and everyday observations.

description.zh: 把零散灵感整理成一座持续生长的数字花园。
description.en: A growing digital garden for small ideas and open questions.

description.zh: 关于生成艺术、网页交互与可视化的小实验。
description.en: Small studies in generative art, interaction, and visualization.
